description: Preview first, 30-day undo. Soft-delete an asset (sets archived_at). Original rows are preserved for versioning. Reviewed and reversible: first call preview_destructive_change({ tool: "archive_asset", arguments: { asset_id } }), which stores the exact change without applying it. After the user confirms, call archive_asset with preview_id, restore_window_acknowledged: true and request_id; the reviewed preview is applied exactly and a changed record is refused. Returns restore_id; restore_change({ restore_id }) undoes it for 30 days unless the record was edited since. ($0.05; API key required)

preview_id.description: preview_id returned by preview_destructive_change for this tool.

request_id.description: Required idempotency key; retries return the original receipt.

restore_window_acknowledged.description: Must be true after reviewing the preview and its 30-day restore window.

name: archive_asset

restore_id.description: Pass to restore_change to undo within restore_window_days.

title: Archive Asset
